answer_1.quote: we trained a Transformer-based NMT system for German-to-English translation on the Europarl v7 corpus
answer_1.outputs: The paper analyzes attention mechanisms in Transformer models rather than focusing on the generated text outputs themselves.

answer_2.quote: we evaluated the derived alignment using the alignment error rate (AER). A low AER score indicates that the extracted word alignments are close to the reference.
